subject: Horizon & Redwood — Mini Unplugged: partner integration pilot
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Chaudhry <samir@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mini Unplugged pilot — quick idea and ask

Hi Sofia,

Hope you're well — enjoyed your talk at CloudCatalyst last week. Horizon has been putting together a small partner pilot that combines a short conversational "unplugged" podcast (30 minutes) with a compact hands-on lab (90 minutes) where we walk through a real integration: Horizon's analytics dashboard calling Redwood embeddings + a small chat layer.

We think a three-city micro-roadshow (SF, Austin, Boston) with a single livestream for APAC/EU would be a low-friction way to generate partner leads and joint content. Would Redwood be open to co-hosting one podcast episode + the SF hands-on lab?

Key asks from our side:
- Redwood exec/senior engineer as co-host on the podcast (30 min)
- 1 speaker for the hands-on lab (30–45m demo + Q&A)
- Shared social promotion window: 3 weeks lead + 2 follow-ups
- Joint registration form and lead-sharing via HubSpot (we can set the form)

I've attached a draft agenda and a one-pager on the lab flow. If this sounds interesting, can we lock a short planning call this week?

Thanks — Maria

--
Maria Santos
Head of Partnerships, Horizon Analytics
maria@horizon-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Horizon-Redwood_MiniUnplugged_Agenda.pdf (PDF), podcast_outline.md (text)

Hi Maria — great to hear from you and thanks for the kind words.

Love the concept. Redwood can definitely participate in the podcast and co-run the SF lab. Quick notes from my side:
- Podcast co-host: I can host, and I think we should also have one of our lead engineers on the panel to answer deep integration questions (Karthik, assigning to you).
- Speaker for SF lab: we can provide a field engineer to do the live demo + a short primer on batching/caching patterns for low-latency embeddings.
- Lead capture & sharing: happy to use a joint HubSpot form. Can you share the fields you need and any compliance notes for PII?
- Budget/booth: Redwood can cover a small tabletop presence in SF if Horizon covers travel for our engineer. Otherwise we can explore a shared sponsor table.

Let's do a 30-minute planning call on Thursday 9/23 at 10am PT — works for you?

I'll loop in Karthik and Laura for comms and logistics.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, Sofia + Maria — excited about this. A few practical items from engineering/field perspective:

1) Demo scope: to keep the lab reliable in a 90-minute slot we should pre-bake a small dataset and a working notebook that highlights: embeddings->semantic search -> small chat flow (using Redwood hosted endpoints or a dedicated demo instance).
2) Environment: If Horizon wants to use their own cloud account for the lab, we'll need a short runbook for auth and rate limits. Otherwise we can provision a temporary demo stack on Redwood Dedicated with a single reserved instance.
3) Speaker logistics: I can do the demo if travel is covered. Alternative: senior field engineer (Marcus or Ben) could lead the in-person lab while I join remotely to handle backend questions.
4) Promo assets: Laura, can you produce a 1-slide one-pager and 3 social copy variants for LinkedIn/Twitter? We should include an early-bird registration link with a small partner code.

Agenda suggestion for SF lab (rough):
- 5m welcome / intros
- 15m podcast-style conversation (recorded)
- 10m setup & environment walkthrough
- 30m live integration demo (notebook + dashboard)
- 20m hands-on exercises (attendees follow a guided notebook)
- 10m closing + lead capture

Happy to jump on the planning call on Thursday.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
